scope.purpose: Freeze the source-to-local notation, normalization, spinor, Grassmann, composite-connection, and first-jet conventions needed to transcribe the selected Hohl component transformations. This artifact contains no tangency calculation.
forbidden_inferences: a canonical Dirac bracket or first-class closure

source_packet.hash_cross_check: The Hohl version, main-TeX filename, and SHA-256 below exactly match the source packet.

source_basis.source_role: The only Phase 15A parent for off-shell component fields and local-supersymmetry transformations.

source_role_guard.CHENG_DEATH_MONIZ_1994_V2: time-gauge convention cross-check only; no imported k=+1 transformation
source_role_guard.CAPOVILLA_GUVEN_1994_V1: pure self-dual Bianchi control only; no matter transformation

source_basis.anchor_policy: Equation labels refer to the frozen main-TeX hash. Unlabeled matter-transformation displays are anchored by subsection and TeX line neighborhood; no coefficient may be replaced from another source.

index_conventions.summation: Repeated one-up/one-down indices are summed. Any exceptional same-height contraction must be displayed with the appropriate epsilon tensor.
index_conventions.complex_conjugate_index_map: alpha <-> dot_alpha; an undotted lower Weyl spinor is conjugate to a dotted lower Weyl spinor before optional epsilon raising.

adm_normalization.metric_components: g_00=-N^2+h_ij N^i N^j, g_0i=h_ij N^j, g_ij=h_ij
adm_normalization.tetrad_decomposition: e_0^a=N n^a+N^i e_i^a with eta_ab n^a n^b=-1 and eta_ab n^a e_i^b=0
adm_normalization.source_to_local_map: N_local=N_Hohl[e], (N^i)_local=(N^i)_Hohl[e], and h_ij_local=h_ij_Hohl[e]; these are derived coordinates on tetrad space, not additional independent fields
adm_normalization.gauge_status: No N=a, N=1, or N^i=0 gauge is imposed. The nonzero-lapse/time-orientation patch and component chart are frozen in PHASE15A_MODE_COMPENSATOR_LEDGER.json.

lorentz_and_orientation_conventions.tetrad_patch: det(e_m^a) is nonzero. Time orientation and the ADM chart are frozen separately in PHASE15A_MODE_COMPENSATOR_LEDGER.json; no N=a gauge is made here.

compact_cell.role: V_0 enters the later homogeneous action integral only and does not rescale the local Hohl transformations.

barred_gravitino_ledger_bridge.source_and_local_transformation_field: Hohl and the direct local component map use Psi_bar_{m dot_alpha}=M_P psi_bar_{m dot_alpha} with a lower dotted index.
barred_gravitino_ledger_bridge.mode_ledger_generator: The mode ledger uses Psi_bar_m^{dot_alpha}:=epsilon^{dot_alpha dot_beta} Psi_bar_{m dot_beta} as its actual barred-gravitino exterior generator; Psi_bar_{m dot_alpha} is reconstructed by lowering and is not a second independent generator.
barred_gravitino_ledger_bridge.jet_bridge: dot_Psi_bar_m^{dot_alpha}:=epsilon^{dot_alpha dot_beta} dot_Psi_bar_{m dot_beta}; epsilon is constant, so no extra jet term occurs.
barred_gravitino_ledger_bridge.transformation_bridge: Transcribe every frozen source variation for Psi_bar_{m dot_alpha} first, apply the local M_P scaling, and only then raise its free dotted index with epsilon^{dot_alpha dot_beta} before the mode projection.
barred_gravitino_ledger_bridge.lorentz_bridge: The raised field transforms as delta_K Psi_bar_m^{dot_alpha}=Psi_bar_m^{dot_beta}(L_bar)_{dot_beta}{}^{dot_alpha}, where L_bar is defined by raising the exact Hohl lower-dotted action with the same frozen epsilon tensors. No independent sign, phase, or generator normalization is introduced.

sigma_matrices.lower_vector_index_rule: sigma_a=eta_ab sigma^b and bar_sigma_a=eta_ab bar_sigma^b; in particular sigma_0=-sigma^0 and bar_sigma_0=-bar_sigma^0
sigma_matrices.curved_index_rule: sigma_m=e_m^a sigma_a, bar_sigma_m=e_m^a bar_sigma_a, sigma^m=e_a^m sigma^a, and bar_sigma^m=e_a^m bar_sigma^a

weyl_conjugation.odd_product: (chi_alpha psi_beta)^*=-chi_bar_dot_alpha psi_bar_dot_beta in the frozen Hohl ordering
weyl_conjugation.parameter: (epsilon^alpha)^*=epsilon_bar^{dot_alpha}; epsilon and epsilon_bar are a conjugate Weyl pair, not independent complex parameters

majorana_packaging.rule: No four-component Majorana matrix or charge-conjugation convention may be introduced without a separately frozen explicit Weyl-to-Majorana basis map.

local_lorentz_compensator_convention.parameter: K^{de}(t) is real, even, antisymmetric, and L=(1/2) K^{de} G_de exactly as in the frozen Hohl source.
local_lorentz_compensator_convention.index_action: Every upper Lorentz index transforms by right action +L and every lower Lorentz index by the dual action -L, using the exact Hohl index placement. Tetrad, Psi, Psi_bar, chi, chi_bar, and b therefore share one K^{de}; no independent spinor rephasing or relative rescaling is allowed.
local_lorentz_compensator_convention.mixed_spinor_endomorphism_rule: For an undotted mixed matrix A_alpha{}^beta acting on an upper-index row spinor v^alpha from the right, delta_K A=-L A+A L=[A,L], so delta_K(v A)=(v A)L. The barred rule is its frozen conjugate after the explicit epsilon-raising bridge: delta_K A_bar=[A_bar,L_bar] and delta_K(v_bar A_bar)=(v_bar A_bar)L_bar.
local_lorentz_compensator_convention.spinor_rule: Apply the displayed G blocks plus the upper/lower-index rule rather than an informal sigma_ab convention. This also freezes the barred action by the source conjugation relation.
regressions_required: the barred spinor action is the frozen complex conjugate of the unbarred action
the induced right-acting Gamma_i and P_3/2 obey delta Gamma_i=[Gamma_i,L] and delta P_3/2=[P_3/2,L], so rho=0 is Lorentz covariant

grassmann_conventions.supercommutation: A B=(-1)^(parity(A) parity(B)) B A for pure objects
grassmann_conventions.product_conjugation: Conjugation follows the frozen Hohl same-order convention with the parity sign made explicit; expressions may not silently reverse and then reorder odd factors.

left_odd_derivative.leibniz: partial_L(X Y)=(partial_L X) Y+(-1)^parity(X) X (partial_L Y)

right_odd_derivative.left_right_relation: partial_L F=(-1)^(parity(F)+1) F partial_R for homogeneous F

exterior_algebra.normal_form: Sort each monomial by the total odd-generator order frozen in PHASE15A_MODE_COMPENSATOR_LEDGER.json and include the exact Koszul sign.
exterior_algebra.coefficient_ring: An even commutative exact symbolic ring; allowed localizations are frozen only in PHASE15A_MODE_COMPENSATOR_LEDGER.json.

planck_and_field_normalization.source_unit_statement: Hohl writes e^{-1} L=-R/2+... with no explicit M_P in the frozen eq:component_fields_action_all.
planck_and_field_normalization.local_action_definition: S_local=M_P^2 S_Hohl with M_P>0 and unchanged spacetime coordinates.
planck_and_field_normalization.interpretation_guard: This is a source-to-local Lagrangian normalization definition. It does not construct canonical phase-space variables, a Dirac bracket, or a canonical generator.

source_to_local_fields.map: M_local=M_Hohl, M_bar_local=M_bar_Hohl, and (b_a)_local=(b_a)_Hohl; their action terms retain the overall M_P^2 by this explicit convention
epsilon=xi and epsilon_bar=xi_bar; no parameter rephasing or rescaling

planck_and_field_normalization.normalization_check: At the action level, M_P^2(-R/2)=-M_P^2 R/2; each quadratic source kinetic or F F_bar term built from varphi, chi_Hohl, F_Hohl, or psi_Hohl loses the overall M_P^2 after the displayed local-field substitution; and the translated vielbein variation carries 1/M_P. This is only a Lagrangian coefficient check, not a phase-space canonicality claim.

component_projection_map.local_definition: Psi=M_P psi_Hohl and Psi_bar=M_P psi_bar_Hohl; the factor 1/2 belongs to the supervielbein projection and is not removed
complex conjugates of the unbarred maps with the frozen Grassmann ordering

second_order_composite_spin_connection.source_projection: Omega_b{}^a||=dz^m Omega_{mb}{}^a|:=dz^m omega_{mb}{}^a=:omega_b{}^a, with the analogous undotted and dotted spinor-connection projections in eq:component_fields_definition_sugra_spin_connection
second_order_composite_spin_connection.source_vector_to_spinor_map: omega_{m(beta alpha)}=+(1/2)(sigma^{ba} epsilon_spinor)_{beta alpha} omega_{mba} and omega_{m(dot beta dot alpha)}=+(1/2)(epsilon_spinor bar_sigma^{ba})_{dot beta dot alpha} omega_{mba}, exactly as in eq:component_fields_definition_sugra_spin_connection_id; parentheses denote the displayed symmetric spinor-index pair, and mixed spinor indices are obtained only with the frozen epsilon tensors
second_order_composite_spin_connection.source_torsion_equation: D_n e_m^a-D_m e_n^a=(i/2)(psi_n sigma^a psi_bar_m-psi_m sigma^a psi_bar_n)
second_order_composite_spin_connection.source_formula: omega_mnp=(1/2)(e_m^a partial_n e_pa-e_p^a partial_m e_na-e_n^a partial_p e_ma)-(1/2)(e_m^a partial_p e_na-e_n^a partial_m e_pa-e_p^a partial_n e_ma)+(i/4)(psi_p sigma_m psi_bar_n-psi_m sigma_n psi_bar_p-psi_n sigma_p psi_bar_m)-(i/4)(psi_n sigma_m psi_bar_p-psi_m sigma_p psi_bar_n-psi_p sigma_n psi_bar_m)
second_order_composite_spin_connection.local_formula: omega_mnp=(1/2)(e_m^a partial_n e_pa-e_p^a partial_m e_na-e_n^a partial_p e_ma)-(1/2)(e_m^a partial_p e_na-e_n^a partial_m e_pa-e_p^a partial_n e_ma)+(i/(4 M_P^2))(Psi_p sigma_m Psi_bar_n-Psi_m sigma_n Psi_bar_p-Psi_n sigma_p Psi_bar_m)-(i/(4 M_P^2))(Psi_n sigma_m Psi_bar_p-Psi_m sigma_p Psi_bar_n-Psi_p sigma_n Psi_bar_m)
second_order_composite_spin_connection.local_translation: The local formula is the exact source identity after psi_Hohl=Psi/M_P and psi_bar_Hohl=Psi_bar/M_P. The vector-to-spinor map above is then applied without an extra rescaling. No independent omega jet is added.
second_order_composite_spin_connection.homogeneous_dependency: After partial_i=0, omega remains an exact composite of e_m^a, its allowed first time jets, Psi_m, and Psi_bar_m. Isotropy is not imposed here.

frozen_matter_specialization.yang_mills_substitution: All source terms containing a_m^r, lambda^r, lambda_bar^r, D^r, or a representation generator T_r are exactly absent, not retained as tunable zeros.
frozen_matter_specialization.superpotential: W is identically zero, so W and every holomorphic or Kähler-covariant derivative of W vanish identically. This does not set spacetime or supercovariant derivatives of Z or Z_bar to zero; their homogeneous time jets remain independent.
frozen_matter_specialization.source_kahler_connection: A_m+(i/2)e_m^a b_a=(1/4)(varphi_bar partial_m varphi-varphi partial_m varphi_bar)+(i/4)(chi_Hohl sigma_m chi_bar_Hohl)
frozen_matter_specialization.local_kahler_connection: A_m+(i/2)e_m^a b_a=(1/(4 M_P^2))(Z_bar partial_m Z-Z partial_m Z_bar)+(i/(4 M_P^2))(chi sigma_m chi_bar)

local_matter_derivatives_used_in_F_trans.nabla_m_chi: partial_m chi-omega_m chi-(1/(4 M_P^2))(Z_bar partial_m Z-Z partial_m Z_bar) chi-(i/(4 M_P^2))(chi sigma_m chi_bar) chi
local_matter_derivatives_used_in_F_trans.nabla_m_chi_bar: partial_m chi_bar-omega_bar_m chi_bar+(1/(4 M_P^2))(Z_bar partial_m Z-Z partial_m Z_bar) chi_bar+(i/(4 M_P^2))(chi sigma_m chi_bar) chi_bar
local_matter_derivatives_used_in_F_trans.derivation: These are M_P times Hohl eq:component_fields_matter_dterm_nabla_chi and _nabla_chib after no vectors, one flat chiral field, Z=M_P varphi, and chi_local=M_P chi_Hohl. omega_m and omega_bar_m are the frozen undotted/dotted spinor connections induced by the same composite omega(e,Psi).
local_matter_derivatives_used_in_F_trans.sign_regression: The Kähler and cubic-fermion terms have minus signs for chi and plus signs for chi_bar, exactly as the frozen conjugate pair.

frozen_matter_specialization.homogeneity: All partial_i of component fields and epsilon vanish as a kinematic ansatz on the invariant Bianchi-I frame. This does not set anisotropic, off-diagonal, lapse, shift, psi_0, or auxiliary components to zero.
frozen_matter_specialization.auxiliary_basis_for_stage_a: Use the original component auxiliaries M, M_bar, b_a, F, and F_bar defined by R|=-M/6, G_a|=-b_a/3, and the chiral projections. In particular, do not replace b_a by the action-summary diagonalized field b_tilde_a=b_a-(3/4)(chi sigma_a chi_bar). For W identically zero and no vectors the displayed M/F diagonalizations collapse, but this does not authorize the nontrivial b redefinition in a transformation or defining function.

bosonic_body_diagnostic_policy.full_off_shell_requirement: K1 must retain and display every algebraic term in the original auxiliaries M,M_bar,b_a,F,F_bar that survives the frozen W-identically-zero, no-vector specialization. No auxiliary equation of motion, diagonalizing field redefinition, or zero assignment is permitted.
bosonic_body_diagnostic_policy.required_output_split: Write the homogeneous bosonic constraint before any auxiliary elimination as C_off_shell=C_EH+chiral_kinetic+C_auxiliary, with C_auxiliary shown separately and with its source normalization traceable to the frozen Hohl action.
bosonic_body_diagnostic_policy.phase14_skeleton_comparison: The diagnostic C_B=-p_X^2+p_T^2+p_Y^2, X=sqrt(6) M_P ln(a), refers only to a positively densitized Einstein-plus-chiral-kinetic Legendre subblock. It is not the full auxiliary-complete off-shell constraint and does not assert C_auxiliary=0.
bosonic_body_diagnostic_policy.exact_coordinate_bridge: On the frozen a>0 patch use dX=sqrt(6) M_P da/a and p_X=a p_a/(sqrt(6) M_P). This verifies the X normalization algebraically without adjoining ln(a) to the local residual/compensator coefficient ring.
bosonic_body_diagnostic_policy.failure_guard: An executable that obtains C_B by deleting, solving, or silently suppressing any surviving auxiliary term fails K1 scope even if the kinetic subblock agrees exactly.

translation_algorithm: Start from the exact Hohl component equation under the frozen main-TeX hash.
Apply only the preregistered one-neutral-chiral, K=varphi varphi_bar, W identically zero, and no-Yang-Mills substitutions in source-normalized fields.
Substitute varphi=Z/M_P, psi_Hohl=Psi/M_P, chi_Hohl=chi/M_P, and F_Hohl=F/M_P, including conjugates.
Multiply the transformed left-hand side by its local field scale: M_P for Psi, Z, chi, and F; one for e, M, M_bar, and b.
Preserve source factor order and exact Grassmann signs; perform no field rephasing, sign repair, equation-of-motion substitution, or compensator insertion.
transformation_import_policy.fermion_order_policy: Retain every fermion order in the selected off-shell source transformations. A term may disappear only by the frozen no-vector, W-identically-zero, one-flat-chiral specialization or an exact exterior-algebra zero; no quadratic or higher fermion truncation is allowed.
transformation_import_policy.all_signs_authority: Every plus/minus sign and factor in every selected component transformation is the byte-frozen Hohl equation under the recorded TeX hash followed only by the displayed specialization and multiplicative field map. The examples below are regression sentinels, not a replacement for the complete source equations.
leading_sign_regressions: delta e_m^a=+i(xi sigma^a psi_bar_m)+i(xi_bar bar_sigma^a psi_m) in Hohl variables
delta psi_m^alpha starts with +2 nabla_m xi^alpha
delta psi_bar_m_dot_alpha starts with +2 nabla_m xi_bar_dot_alpha
delta varphi=+sqrt(2) xi chi and delta varphi_bar=+sqrt(2) xi_bar chi_bar

delta chi starts with +i sqrt(2)(xi_bar bar_sigma^m epsilon_spinor)_alpha(D_m varphi-psi_m chi/sqrt(2))+sqrt(2) xi_alpha F; epsilon_spinor here is the antisymmetric index tensor, not the local SUSY parameter epsilon

families.local_fields: Z, Z_bar, chi, chi_bar, F, F_bar

j1_transformation_dependency_ledger.jet_space: First homogeneous jet space J^1; no equation of motion relates independent jets.
j1_transformation_dependency_ledger.parameter_index_guard: The independent unbarred parameter may be stored as epsilon^alpha or epsilon_alpha, but never both: epsilon_alpha=epsilon_{alpha beta} epsilon^beta. Its conjugate is (epsilon^alpha)^*=epsilon_bar^dot_alpha, with epsilon_bar_dot_alpha obtained by the frozen dotted epsilon tensor.

required_first_time_jet_families.reason: D_n psi_m in delta M, delta M_bar, and delta b; the mode ledger must determine which components survive homogeneity without deleting psi_0
matter covariant derivatives and the composite Kahler connection
nabla_m chi in delta F and delta F_bar
nabla_m epsilon in delta Psi_m and delta Psi_bar_m

j1_transformation_dependency_ledger.spatial_jets: partial_i of homogeneous component fields and parameters are exactly zero by the homogeneous ansatz, not by an equation of motion.
j1_transformation_dependency_ledger.adm_chart_guard: N, N^i, and their retained jets are a chart of e_m^a data to be frozen in PHASE15A_MODE_COMPENSATOR_LEDGER.json. They are not added as independent variables simultaneously with all sixteen e_m^a components.
j1_transformation_dependency_ledger.psi_0_guard: Psi_0 and Psi_bar_0 remain base fields. The later mode ledger may prove that particular time jets do not occur after exact antisymmetric contractions, but may not delete the fields before that check.

dependency_by_variation.delta_e: base odd fields and epsilon; no field first derivative
dependency_by_variation.delta_Psi: partial_0 epsilon, composite omega(partial_0 e,Psi), partial_0 Z through the Kahler connection, and base auxiliaries
dependency_by_variation.delta_M_and_delta_M_bar: partial_0 Psi, composite omega(partial_0 e,Psi), partial_0 Z through the Kahler connection and matter derivative, and base fields
dependency_by_variation.delta_b: partial_0 Psi, composite omega(partial_0 e,Psi), partial_0 Z through the Kahler connection and matter derivative, and base fields
dependency_by_variation.delta_F_and_delta_F_bar: partial_0 chi, partial_0 Z, composite omega(partial_0 e,Psi), and base fields

j1_transformation_dependency_ledger.component_expansion_authority: PHASE15A_MODE_COMPENSATOR_LEDGER.json must expand these index families into the complete retained/discarded component and odd-generator lists before any executable is created.

source_typography_packets.source_location: Immediately after eq:component_fields_sugra_transf_gravitino_2 in the frozen Hohl TeX
source_typography_packets.issue: The displayed definitions have free index m on nabla_m xi but use n in the Kahler-connection terms; the barred definition also prints omega_n. Taken literally, the equations have unmatched free indices.
source_typography_packets.frozen_emendation: Only inside the two displayed definitions of nabla_m xi and nabla_m xi_bar, replace each unmatched n in omega_n, D_n varphi, D_n varphi_bar, and sigma_n by the already-free derivative index m. Change no coefficient, sign, factor ordering, conjugation rule, or any n appearing as a genuinely summed dummy index elsewhere.
source_scoped_justification: The left-hand side and leading partial/connection terms define a covariant derivative carrying exactly the one free spacetime index m; the printed n has no contraction partner and is therefore not a well-formed tensor expression.

The adjacent frozen component identity for the Kahler connection is A_m+(i/2)e_m^a b_a=(1/4)(K_k D_m varphi^k-K_kbar D_m varphi_bar^kbar)+(i/4)g(chi sigma_m chi_bar), fixing the same m-indexed combination.
Applying m-for-n to both barred and unbarred definitions restores their frozen complex-conjugation relation without importing a coefficient from another source.
exact_regressions_required: Every term in the emended unbarred definition has free-index signature (m,alpha), and every term in the barred definition has (m,dot_alpha).
Complex conjugation under the frozen Weyl and Grassmann rules maps the emended pair into each other.
The Kahler-connection portion equals the adjacent frozen A_m expression after the stated one-field specialization and field normalization.
semantic_mutants_required: The literal-source n-index transcription is rejected for an unmatched free n.
Replacing n by m in only one member of the barred/unbarred pair is rejected by conjugation covariance.
A global n-to-m text replacement outside these two definitions is rejected as an overbroad source mutation.
source_typography_packets.scope_guard: This is a pre-executable typography repair forced by index well-formedness and an adjacent equation from the same byte-frozen source. It is not a fitted tangency term or evidence for the target claim.

source_typography_packets.source_location: Unlabeled conjugate-chi transformation in sec:component_fields_sugra_transformations / Matter multiplet
source_typography_packets.issue: One connection term prints an undotted xi with a dotted index and a later factor prints chi_bar with unbarred species index k. The connection term vanishes because Gamma_bar=0, and the unique one-field specialization removes species ambiguity; no corrected nonzero coefficient is inferred.
frozen_handling: Apply the frozen one-flat-chiral specialization Gamma_bar=0 before transcribing the malformed Christoffel term. The entire term is exactly zero; do not emend its dotted parameter glyph and do not infer a nonzero coefficient.

In the surviving Kähler-weight term only, replace the outer free field glyph chi_bar^{k dot_alpha} by chi_bar^{kbar dot_alpha}. Do not change the inner summed labels, coefficient, sign, factor order, or parameter glyphs.
source_typography_packets.source_scoped_justification: The transformed field on the left carries the barred matter label kbar, and the frozen unbarred transformation plus Weyl/species conjugation fixes its conjugate outer field to chi_bar^{kbar}. In the one-field model this is also the unique barred species. This repair imports no equation from another source.
exact_regressions_required: Gamma_bar=0 makes the malformed Christoffel term exactly zero before any free-index evaluation.
The surviving emended Kähler-weight term has the same free barred species and dotted-spinor indices as delta chi_bar^{kbar dot_alpha}.
Frozen complex conjugation maps the unbarred and emended barred Kähler-weight terms into each other with the source coefficient and sign.
semantic_mutants_required: Any implementation assigning a nonzero value to the malformed Gamma_bar term is rejected.
The literal unbarred outer species glyph in the surviving barred term is rejected before the one-species numerical collapse.
Changing the coefficient, sign, inner summed species labels, or Grassmann order while repairing the outer glyph is rejected.

readiness.readiness_reason: The convention map has no unresolved source-index blocker, but the contract requires this map, the source packet, and the mode-compensator ledger to be jointly audited and committed before a separate executable commit may be created.
